race.comment: VICTORIOUS RULER (6) had genuine excuses from the wide gate on resumption when she sat outside the leader on the fast tempo before tiring in the straight to finish eighth over 1400m at Rosehill. Blinkers go on from the right draw and Rachel King retains the ride. Sure to be thereabouts. I AM DYNASTY (3) well-bred colt improving with racing. Took control early at a genuine clip and was safely held once headed in the straight to run third in a Super Maiden over 1400m at Illawarra Grange. Blinkers go on and deserves another chance over this trip. MARCH (4) made a slashing debut when unwanted in betting ($21), stalking the speed to run third over 1300m at Illawarra Grange. Must contend with a sticky draw but is not to be overlooked at this trip. YOUR ATTITUDE (11) handy return from back in the field with a closing fifth over 1400m in a Super Maiden at Rosehill. Claim helps again from the low gate. Sure to be around the money.
